title: What a Godly Man's Leadership Looks Like When He's Not in Charge of Anything
caption:
A godly man doesn't wait for a title before he leads. He just goes first into the thing everyone else is avoiding.

He apologizes first, even when he's not sure he's owed one back. He brings up the hard conversation everyone's thinking and nobody's saying. He shows up before he's asked. And he kneels before he leads, because Christ washed feet before he gave a single order.

Authority that isn't borrowed from Him doesn't hold up long.

theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
